text.description_html:
RK International CK-317, Retro Black Porcelain Cabinet Knob with Metal Tip

The 1 Inch Black Porcelain Cabinet Knob with Metal Center is a glamorous retro knob that commands the style of the surrounding area. It is available with either a polished brass base and center or a polished chrome finish. It is easy to install with the included mounting hardware.

Also Available Matching: 1-1/4" Black Porcelain Cabinet Knob with Metal Center and 1" White Porcelain Cabinet Knob with Metal Center

Specifications and Features of the RK International CK 317 Retro Black Porcelain Knob with Metal Tip:

  • Material: porcelain with some brass
  • Porcelain Color: Black
  • Diameter: 1"
  • Projection: 1-1/8"
  • Screw: 1" long #8 - 32 machine screw.
  • Packaged with all necessary installation hardware.

Sold Individually
